scope: Treat existing public-side walls and seat contacts within the registered E1 intervention. Keep the E1 route and published files.

observations.observation: Visible joints, chipped edges and separate courses along a recess. The physical impression is used only for public edges.
Walk edge and low assemblage of stone, warm grey irregular faces with local ground planting.
Uneven pale stone ledgers, breaks in joint spacing, worn corners and nearby loose laid stones.
Separated clumps and soft vegetation along built edges; no extension into undocumented interior.
The wall edge and scene path are distinct, with a clipped shrub at the road-side wall end.
